text:
Ava: async milestone rundown — quick heads-up for M-3 (routing + canary). TL;DR: canary routing shipped to 10% yesterday, perf looks good, one e2e regression on embeddings slipped into next sprint. Owners and immediate asks below.

Ava: shipped
- Canary routing rollout 10% (Ravi)
- Docs update for route config (Elena)

Ava: slipped
- Embedding consistency test failing on long sequences (Morgan) — root cause investigation ongoing, assigning to Morgan + QA.

Ava: open CRs / ops
- Ravi: 2 runtime PRs blocking canary bump to 50% (need design signoff on fallback UX)
- Morgan: infra PR for kv-cache warmup (waiting CR review)

Ava: asks
- Ravi, Morgan: status + ETA on PRs? any help needed to unblock reviews?
- Chi: where are we on UX copy for fallback? we want minimal user impact if canary flips back.
- QA-Bot: can you run targeted e2e for embeddings with 8k+ contexts this week?

Ravi: runtime PRs — one is ready, other needs a small refactor (I'll push patch today). ETA to reviewers: EOD tomorrow.

Morgan: embedding regression — looks like a kv-cache eviction mismatch with quantized models. I've got a repro, digging into a fix; optimistic for a patch by Tue. Need Elena to re-run the embedding golden set after patch.

Chi: fallback copy ready in Figma, 2 variants. Putting both options in product doc, recommend the shorter one for latency-sensitive apps.

Elena: docs update is live for the route config. Linking: https://confluence.redwood/route-config/M-3

Ava: thanks. @Ravi when you push the patch can you also add a note in the PR about potential perf tradeoffs? want to track it in the rollout doc.

Ravi: yes — will add perf note + a small benchmark snippet.

Ravi: benchmark snippet (local):
```
python bench/routes_bench.py --model redwood-alpha --seq 2048 --requests 200
```

QA-Bot: scheduled e2e run for embeddings with long contexts: queued for 2026-03-20 03:00 UTC. Will post results here.

Deploybot: canary bump to 50% blocked until runtime PR merged and tests green.

Morgan: quick ask — any bandwidth for a review pair on the infra PR? pinging @Ravi and @Elena since they know the kv-cache surface.

Elena: I can review tomorrow morning.

Ava: next steps (owners):
- Ravi: land runtime patch + add perf notes (ETA EOD tomorrow)
- Morgan: patch for kv eviction + re-run embeddings golden set (ETA Tue)
- Elena: doc & infra PR review (ETA tomorrow AM)
- Chi: finalize fallback copy and update product doc (ETA Tue)
- QA-Bot: run e2e and report (job scheduled)

Ava: if no major regressions from QA we'll plan a canary bump to 50% on Wed and full rollout next week pending metrics. If anything blocks, drop a short note here with severity and owner. :thumbsup:

Ravi: noted. will post PR link when ready.

Morgan: will share repro and test matrix in the infra PR.

Elena: reviewing the infra PR tomorrow, will flag anything blocking.

Chi: will post final copy versions and annotate recommended option in the product doc.

Ava: thanks all — short and async is perfect here.

QA-Bot: e2e run completed: 2026-03-20 03:12 UTC — 1 failure (embedding consistency). Details: mismatch on sequence length 8192 with quantized-8. Assigned to Morgan.

Morgan: got the QA failure, patch in progress. updating the PR with test case.

Ava: keeping this thread open for updates — please ping if you need a quick sync.
